messages.content:
Title: Diagnosis
Details: 

The test `isUnixSymlinkIsFalseIfMoreThanOneFlagIsSet` failed because it expected `isUnixSymlink()` to return false for a zip entry with multiple flags set, specifically for the "META-INF/maven/" entry in the test jar.

Inspecting the `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()` method reveals that it returns true if the Unix mode, masked with `UnixStat.LINK_FLAG`, exactly equals `UnixStat.LINK_FLAG`. The method implementation is:
```java
public boolean isUnixSymlink() {
    return (getUnixMode() & UnixStat.LINK_FLAG) == UnixStat.LINK_FLAG;
}
```
where `UnixStat.LINK_FLAG = 0120000` (octal, a specific file type flag for symlinks).

The `getUnixMode()` method returns the Unix mode bits only if the platform is UNIX, extracting bits from `getExternalAttributes()` so that the mode is `(externalAttributes >> 16) & 0xFFFF`.

The current bug report states that for permissions 177777 (octal), the current method mistakenly returns that the entry is a Unix symlink. This permission value 177777 includes extra bits beyond the `LINK_FLAG`. Because the current check uses an exact mask equality `(flags & LINK_FLAG) == LINK_FLAG`, it returns true even if other bits are present in the mode, which is not correct. The test expects symlink detection to return false if multiple flags are set (not only the symlink bit).

The root cause is that the `isUnixSymlink()` method does not account for additional bits being set in the mode. It only tests for the presence of the symlink bit using an equality comparison that allows extra bits to be present as long as the symlink bit is set. Instead, it should ensure that the mode precisely matches the symlink flag and no other file type bits are set, or properly mask out other bits.

Recent bug reports about other unrelated areas do not shed more light on this; the evidence from the code and current report is sufficient.

Hence, the bug is that `isUnixSymlink()` incorrectly identifies entries with more than one file type flag set as symlinks by using an overly permissive check on Unix mode flags.

This explains why the failing test detects a false positive symlink for a zip entry with mode 177777.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
